This endpoint returns only the IR model, without performing CLTS translation.
Useful for debugging, tooling integration, and understanding the IR structure.

get.summary: Get the result of a completed translation job

404.description: Job not found or not completed

get.summary: Get the status of a translation job

ArtifactTypeApi.description: Artifact type for API (serialized as single-key object)

AsyncTranslationResponse.description: Response from starting an async translation job

sample_rate.description: Sample rate in Hz (optional, defaults to 16000)

BatchTranslateBpmRequest.description: Request for batch translation of multiple BPMN files

BatchTranslationResult.description: Result for a single file in batch translation

BehavioralCheckResultApi.description: API representation of behavioral check result

BpmIr.description:
BPMN Intermediate Representation (IR) for API serialization.

This is a serializable representation of the IR model that can be included
in API responses. It mirrors the structure of `BpmModel` but with all fields
serializable to JSON.

corrected_data.description: Optional corrected element data (for name/description changes)

corrected_xml.description: Optional corrected BPMN XML fragment (for structural changes)

description.description: Description of what needs to be changed

target_element.description: Target element (process ID, role ID, or task/gateway ID)

BpmnFeedbackRequest.description: Request to submit feedback on a BPMN draft

bpmn_draft_id.description: BPMN draft ID to provide feedback on
BPMN draft ID this feedback applies to

speaker_hints.description: Speaker hints for better role identification

BpmnGenerationRequest.description: Request for BPMN generation from transcript

BpmnRegenerateRequest.description: Request to regenerate BPMN with feedback incorporated

feedback_ids.description: Optional feedback ID(s) to incorporate (if not provided, uses most recent)

BpmnVersionHistory.description: Version history entry for a BPMN draft

changes_summary.description: Summary of changes in this version

created_at.description: Timestamp when this version was created

feedback_ids.description: Feedback IDs that led to this version

ExtractIrFromSummaryRequest.description: Request for IR extraction from summary

GraphElement.description: Graph element (node or edge) for visualization

GraphTypeResponse.description: Graph type in response (serialized as string)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the job was created (ISO 8601 format)

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the job was last updated (ISO 8601 format)

ProcessContextPipelineRequest.description: Request for full pipeline (summarize + event logs + IR extraction)

StructuralCheckResultApi.description: API representation of structural check result

existing_bpmn.description:
Optional BPMN file content (XML) to use as a starting point/reference
This helps guide transcription, speaker identification, and cleanup when
the interview is about improving or reviewing an existing process

oneOf.description: IR (Intermediate Representation) if requested via options.include_ir
Verification results if requested via options.verify
Verification options - if provided, run property verification

detailed.description: Include detailed results for each check
